🏢 MI HB 6426 — Michigan Cities Could Pause New Data Centers

Large data centers could face tougher local reviews under this new law. It defines key terms like 'large-scale data center' – specifically focusing on facilities with a 25+ megawatt energy load or 50+ megawatt electrical demand – and sets a strict process for developers seeking local approvals. ...
